admission.justification: The log line and the recounted total are one promise about a failing pass; both cases witness it.

applicability: Every sweep or drain pass and receipt read/write helper over a held store.
conditions: A failed pass names the recipient and the reason in one log line.
The receipt's count of held messages is recounted from the store it holds.

_sweep_receipt, _readable_queued_receipt, _refresh_waiting_count, apply_drain_to_receipt, and _apply_drain_result catch HTTPException alongside ValueError on receipt reads and OSError on receipt writes (preserving HeldSeatClosed as a silent False return in apply_drain_to_receipt), logging one warning naming the path and returning cleanly so valid receipts still drain in the same tick.
exclusions: A pass that pauses for an unreadable store is reported under this clause, not swallowed.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_held_queue.py::TurnEndDeliveryTests::test_a_failed_drain_writes_one_line_with_the_recipient_and_the_reason and ::test_a_receipt_count_equals_the_messages_its_store_holds; reading stated in report limitation 2; report role-reports/worker/8500ba4e-39b3-5373-8e2d-cfe91a38af4c/role-launch/260928-MIK-L171-worker-8500ba4e-39b3-5373-8e2d-cfe91a38af4c.md; L171-F04 repair: test_a_ready_drain_that_pauses_writes_one_line_with_the_recipient_and_reason

statement: A drain that fails writes one line naming the recipient and the reason, a receipt's waiting count is recounted from its own store rather than published stale while the store cannot be read, and malformed or non-receipt JSON read or write rejections warn once naming the path and return cleanly without aborting a held-message sweep tick.
title: Failed drains log once and malformed receipts never abort sweeps
